g.title: Long shot. The docks at dawn. Alice, centre; Bob, right. Caption: The docks, before the first ferry. Alice: Nobody here yet.
Medium close-up. The docks at dawn. Bob, centre. Bob: Give it a minute.
Full shot. The docks at dawn. Alice, centre, pointing. Alice: There!
Medium shot. A shore at dawn. Bob, centre, happy. Sound effect: SKREE.
Long shot. The docks by day. Alice, left; Bob, right. Editor's note: This one keeps its border.
